# MindzSpark — MHT-CET Preference List

> Counsellor-reviewed MHT-CET college preference lists for Maharashtra CAP round admissions. A real counsellor checks and finalizes every list before it is delivered — it is never a raw, unreviewed algorithm output.

## What this service is

- Product: MHT-CET college preference list (CAP option-form order), for Maharashtra engineering admissions.
- Price: ₹349, one-time payment, covers 2 personalized preference lists (for 2 separate CAP rounds).
- Inputs used: CET percentile, rank, category, seat type, and preferred cities/branches.
- Process: student submits inputs → an engine drafts a ranked list from historical cutoff data → a human counsellor reviews, reorders, and corrects it → the approved list is delivered.
- Delivery: reviewed and approved within 6 hours of submission; the student is notified by email and can download the list (PDF/Excel) from their dashboard.
- Students can drag-and-drop reorder their list or manually add colleges before submitting for counsellor review.

## What this service is not

- Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to the State CET Cell, Maharashtra, or DTE. Official CAP registration and option-form submission happen only on the official CET Cell portal. This service only advises on what order to fill your own form in.
- Not a substitute for the official CAP process — it is a decision-support and review service.

## Related MindzSpark tools

- Free MHT-CET percentile/rank-to-college predictor: https://mhtcet.mindzspark.in — a free, non-reviewed estimate. The counsellor-reviewed paid list on this domain (collegelist.mindzspark.in) is the finalized, human-checked version for actually filling the CAP form.
